provenance.license: MIT (dataset card at the pinned revision). Credit: Sahar Abdelnabi et al., Microsoft, LLMail-Inject: A Dataset from a Realistic Adaptive Prompt Injection Challenge.
provenance.accessLimits: Public, ungated. The 514 MB release and generated cases stay under ignored evals/private/.
provenance.selection: Both phases' labelled unique submissions with attack_attempt == 'True' and reason in ['api_triggered', 'judge'], parsed as 'Subject of the email: <s>. Body: <b>', body 40-4000 characters. Ordered by SHA-256 of '<seed>/<phase>/<sha256(submission)>', deduplicated by normalized body (whitespace-collapsed, casefolded) and by its first 120 normalized characters. Strata: phase x judge reason x body-length tercile (edges over the deduplicated pool); first 25 per stratum, 300 total.
provenance.labelMeaning: Upstream attack-attempt annotations (API call triggered, or LLM judge), not success against any defense. Attack-only: use caseSelector positive. The case text is Subject plus body as an email. May overlap the private llmail-phase2-positive-400 cohort; do not pool them as independent evidence.
